plain_english: Sickness blocks your body, but not your will — unless you let it. A lame leg blocks your leg, but not your will. Tell yourself this about everything that happens. You'll find it blocks something else, but not truly you.
original_excerpt: Sickness is an impediment to the body, but not to the will unless itself pleases. Lameness is an impediment to the leg, but not to the will; and say this to yourself with regard to everything that happens. For you will find it to be an impediment to something else, but not truly to yourself.
